en.t: Emperor Septimius Severus dies at York
en.s: On 4 February 211, Roman emperor Septimius Severus died at Eboracum, modern York in the United Kingdom. His sons Caracalla and Geta succeeded him.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁在约克去世
zh.s: 211年2月4日，罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁在埃博拉肯去世，即今英国约克。他的两个儿子卡拉卡拉和盖塔继位。

en.s: The Battle of Dathin (Arabic: داثن‎‎) was a minor battle during the Arab–Byzantine Wars between the Rashidun Caliphate and the Byzantine Empire in February 634, but became very famous in the literature of the period. The battle took place following a series of Arab raids around Gaza. The Byzantine commander (dux and candidatus) Sergius assembled a small detachment of soldiers (due to a shortage of troops), and led that mounted army from his base at Caesarea some 125 kilometers south to the vicinity of Gaza. From there he proceeded against an Arab force that was likely numerically superior and commanded by Abu Umamah al-Bahili.

zh.s: 达辛战役是阿拉伯—拜占庭战争期间，正统哈里发国与拜占庭帝国于634年2月进行的一场小规模交战，却在当时文献中广为人知。战前，阿拉伯军队多次袭击加沙周边。拜占庭指挥官塞尔吉乌斯因兵力不足，只能集结一小支部队，率这支骑兵从驻地凯撒利亚南下约125公里，来到加沙附近，再向一支阿拉伯军队进攻。对方很可能人数占优，由阿布·乌马迈·巴希利指挥。

en.s: The 1169 Sicily earthquake occurred on 4 February 1169 at 08:00 local time on the eve of the feast of St. Agatha of Sicily (in southern Italy). It had an estimated magnitude of between 6.4 and 7.3 and an estimated maximum perceived intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. The cities of Catania, Lentini and Modica were severely damaged, and the earthquake also triggered a paleotsunami.

zh.s: 1169年西西里地震于当地时间1169年2月4日8时发生，当天是西西里圣阿加莎节前夜。地震估计震级为6.4至7.3级，麦加利烈度最高估计为X级（极强）。卡塔尼亚、伦蒂尼和莫迪卡等城市遭到严重破坏，地震还引发了古海啸。

en.s: The Battle of Kasahrada (1197) was fought on 4 February 1197 between the Ghurid forces led by their slave-lieutenant Qutubuddin Aibak and the Rajput forces led by Chaulukya ruler Bhima II. It was fought in the present-day state of Rajasthan at Kasahrada, which is at foot of Mount Abu in the southern Aravali hills.

zh.s: 卡萨赫拉达战役于1197年2月4日爆发，古尔王朝军队由奴隶出身的将领库特布丁·艾伊巴克率领，拉杰普特军队由乔卢基亚王朝统治者毗摩二世率领。战场位于今印度拉贾斯坦邦卡萨赫拉达，地处阿拉瓦利山脉南部、阿布山脚下。

en.t: Prussian Confederation renounces obedience to the Teutonic Order
en.s: On 4 February 1454, the Secret Council of the Prussian Confederation sent a formal act of disobedience to the Grand Master of the Teutonic Order. Open rebellion followed two days later, during the events that led to the Thirteen Years’ War.

zh.t: 普鲁士联盟宣布不再服从条顿骑士团
zh.s: 1454年2月4日，普鲁士联盟秘密议会向条顿骑士团大团长发出正式文书，宣布不再服从其统治。两天后，联盟发动公开起义，冲突发展为十三年战争。

en.s: The Battle of Qarabagh was fought on February 4, 1469, between Aq Qoyunlu under Uzun Hasan, and the Timurids of Samarkand under Abu Sa'id Mirza, resulting in the latter's defeat, imprisonment and execution. After the battle, the Timurids forever lost any hopes of gaining Iraq or Iran back into their kingdom.

zh.s: 1469年2月4日，白羊王朝在乌尊·哈桑率领下与撒马尔罕帖木儿王朝军队交战，后者由阿布·赛义德·米尔扎指挥，最终战败、被俘并处决。此役后，帖木儿王朝再也无望将伊拉克或伊朗收回其版图。

en.t: John Rogers is burned at the stake, becoming the first English Protestant martyr under Queen Mary I
en.s: John Rogers (c. 1505 – 4 February 1555) was an English clergyman, Bible translator and commentator. He guided the development of the Matthew Bible in vernacular English during the reign of Henry VIII and was the first English Protestant executed as a heretic under Mary I.

zh.t: 约翰·罗杰斯被火刑处死，成为玛丽一世治下首位英国新教殉道者
zh.s: 约翰·罗杰斯（约1505年—1555年2月4日）是英国牧师、圣经译者和注释家。亨利八世统治期间，他推动了《马太圣经》以英语白话文编译出版。玛丽一世统治期间，他作为异端被处决，成为首位遭处决的英国新教徒。

en.s: The Battle of Sinhagad, also known as Battle of Kondhana, involved an attack by Marathas during the night of 4 February 1670 on the Mughal fort of Sinhagad (then Kondhana), near the city of Pune, Maharashtra. The Marathas captured the fort.

zh.s: 辛哈加德战役又称孔达纳战役。1670年2月4日夜间，马拉塔军队袭击马哈拉施特拉邦浦那附近、由莫卧儿军队控制的辛哈加德堡，当时该堡名为孔达纳。马拉塔军队最终夺取了城堡。

en.t: São José de Macapá established as a town
en.s: On February 4, 1758, São José de Macapá was established as a town in Portuguese Brazil. The settlement became a city in 1854.

zh.s: 1758年2月4日，葡属巴西的圣若泽·德·马卡帕正式建镇。该镇于1854年升格为城市。

en.s: The action of 4 February 1781 was fought off Sombrero, Anguilla, during Fourth Anglo-Dutch War between the British and Dutch navies. A British squadron of two ships of the line and one frigate under Captain Francis Reynolds captured a Dutch ship of the line under Schout-bij-nacht Willem Krul along with a convoy of 30 merchantmen he was escorting.

zh.s: 1781年2月4日，第四次英荷战争期间，英国与荷兰海军在安圭拉松布雷罗岛外海交战。弗朗西斯·雷诺兹舰长率领两艘战列舰和一艘护卫舰，俘获威廉·克吕尔海军少将指挥的一艘荷兰战列舰，以及由其护送的30艘商船。

en.t: Electoral College votes unanimously for George Washington
en.s: On February 4, 1789, electors in the United States voted unanimously for George Washington as the first president. His inauguration followed in April.

zh.t: 选举人一致投票选举华盛顿为美国首任总统
zh.s: 1789年2月4日，美国选举人一致投票选举乔治·华盛顿为首任总统。他于同年4月宣誓就职。

en.t: The Riobamba earthquake strikes Ecuador, causing up to 40,000 casualties
en.s: The 1797 Riobamba earthquake occurred at 12:30 UTC on 4 February. It devastated the city of Riobamba and many other cities in the Interandean valley, causing between 6,000 and 40,000 casualties. It is estimated that seismic intensities in the epicentral area reached at least XI (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale, and that the earthquake had a magnitude of 7.6–8.3, the most powerful historical event known in Ecuador.

zh.t: 里奥班巴地震袭击厄瓜多尔，造成多达4万人伤亡
zh.s: 1797年里奥班巴地震于2月4日世界协调时12时30分发生，摧毁了里奥班巴市和安第斯山间谷地的许多其他城市，造成6000至4万人伤亡。震中地区估计至少达到麦加利烈度XI级（极强），震级估计为7.6至8.3级，是厄瓜多尔已知最强烈的历史地震。

en.s: The Capture of Valdivia was a battle in the Chilean War of Independence between Spanish forces commanded by Colonel Manuel Montoya and the Chilean forces under the command of Lord Cochrane, held on 3 and 4 February 1820.

zh.s: 1820年2月3日至4日，智利独立战争期间，科克伦勋爵率领的智利军队，与曼努埃尔·蒙托亚上校指挥的西班牙军队在瓦尔迪维亚交战。

en.s: The Battle of Uchumayo occurred in the first days of February 1836, on the outskirts of Arequipa, Peru. It was the most important confrontation in the series of skirmishes, prior to the Battle of Socabaya, that the forces of the United Army under the command of Santa Cruz held with the restaurateurs under the command of Salaverry.

zh.s: 乌丘马约战役发生于1836年2月初，战场在秘鲁阿雷基帕郊外。这是圣克鲁斯指挥的联合军与萨拉韦里指挥的复辟派军队在索卡巴亚战役前一系列小规模交战中最重要的一场。

en.s: The Battle of Laguna Limpia, was part of the Argentine Civil Wars. It happened in the southwest of the Corrientes Province, Argentina on 4 February 1846, when the army under Entre Ríos Province governor Justo José de Urquiza, defeated and captured the commander of the vadvanced columns of Corrientes' army, Juan Madariaga.

zh.s: 拉古纳林皮亚战役是阿根廷内战的一部分，于1846年2月4日在科连特斯省西南部发生。恩特雷里奥斯省省长胡斯托·何塞·德·乌尔基萨率军获胜，并俘虏科连特斯军先头纵队指挥官胡安·马达里亚加。

en.s: The Battle of Vízakna was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849 fought on 4 February 1849 between the Hungarian army led by the Polish General Józef Bem and the Austrian army of the Habsburg Commander-in-Chief of Transylvania, Lieutenant General Anton Puchner. The Hungarian national poet Sándor Petőfi participated in the battle in the Hungarian army, then wrote a poem entitled Négy nap dörgött az ágyú (Four days the cannons roared...) in which he described the battle.

zh.s: 1849年2月4日，1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争期间，波兰将军约瑟夫·贝姆率领的匈牙利军队，与哈布斯堡王朝特兰西瓦尼亚总司令安东·普赫纳中将指挥的奥军在维扎克瑙交战。匈牙利民族诗人裴多菲·山多尔以匈军一员的身份参战，随后写下《大炮轰鸣了四天……》一诗，描写这场战役。

en.t: Tischendorf shown more leaves of Codex Sinaiticus
en.s: On February 4, 1859, according to his own account, Constantin von Tischendorf was shown a substantial set of Codex Sinaiticus leaves at Saint Catherine’s Monastery in Sinai, Egypt. He had seen other leaves during an earlier visit in 1844.
en.n: This records the 1859 sighting described by Tischendorf, not his first encounter with leaves in 1844. Accounts of the manuscript’s transfer and ownership remain disputed.

zh.t: 提申多夫见到《西奈抄本》的更多书页
zh.s: 据提申多夫本人记述，1859年2月4日，一名修士在埃及西奈半岛的圣凯瑟琳修道院，向他展示了《西奈抄本》的大量书页。他早在1844年的一次访问中就见过其他书页。
zh.n: 此条记录提申多夫所述的1859年见闻，区别于1844年的首次接触。手稿如何转移及其所有权仍有争议。

en.s: The Battle of La Bolsa was a major event in the Cortina War, a series of armed confrontations between the militia of Mexican rancher Juan Cortina and elements of the United States Army and the Texas Rangers. The battle occurred on February 4, 1860, when Cortina's forces attacked the steamboat Ranchero on its way to Brownsville.

zh.s: 拉博尔萨战役是科尔蒂纳战争中的一场重要战斗。科尔蒂纳战争是一系列武装冲突，交战双方是墨西哥牧场主胡安·科尔蒂纳的民兵与美国陆军及德克萨斯游骑兵部队。1860年2月4日，科尔蒂纳的部队袭击了正驶往布朗斯维尔的“兰切罗号”轮船，战斗由此爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Tétouan (Arabic: معركة تطوان, Spanish: Batalla de Tetuán) was fought from 4 to 6 February 1860, near Tétouan, Morocco, between a Spanish Army sent to North Africa and the tribal levies which at the time made up the Moroccan Army. The battle was part of the Hispano–Moroccan War of 1859–1860.

zh.s: 得土安战役（阿拉伯语：معركة تطوان；西班牙语：Batalla de Tetuán）于1860年2月4日至6日在摩洛哥得土安附近进行，交战双方是被派往北非的西班牙军队和当时组成摩洛哥军队的部族征召兵。战役是1859至1860年西班牙—摩洛哥战争的一部分。

en.s: On February 4, 1861, delegates from seceding Southern states began meeting in Montgomery, Alabama, United States, to organize the Confederate provisional government. The provisional constitution was adopted later.

zh.t: 美国南方代表在蒙哥马利召开会议
zh.s: 1861年2月4日，退出联邦的南方各州代表开始在美国阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利开会，筹建邦联临时政府。临时宪法后来才获得通过。

en.s: Bacardi Limited ( bə-KAR-dee, Spanish: [bakaɾˈði], Catalan: [bəkəɾˈði]) is the largest privately held, family-owned spirits company in the world. Originally known for its Bacardí brand of white rum, it now has a portfolio of more than 200 brands and labels. Founded in Cuba in 1862 by Facundo Bacardí i Massó, a Spanish businessman born in Sitges, Bacardi Limited has been family-owned for seven generations, and employs more than 8,000 people with sales in approximately 170 countries.

zh.s: 百加得有限公司是全球最大的私人家族经营烈酒公司。它最初以百加得白朗姆酒闻名，如今拥有200多个品牌和商标。西班牙商人法昆多·百加得·马索于1862年在古巴创立公司。百加得家族已连续经营七代，公司拥有8000多名员工，产品销往约170个国家。

en.s: The Battle of Rawa was one of skirmishes of the Polish January Uprising. It took place on 4 February 1863 in the town of Rawa Mazowiecka, Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A unit of Polish insurgents under Antoni Jeziorański, and Aleksander and Franciszek Sokołowski, managed to capture barracks of the Imperial Russian Army. The remaining Russians retreated towards Skierniewice.

zh.s: 拉瓦战役是波兰一月起义期间的一场小规模战斗，于1863年2月4日在俄罗斯控制的波兰王国拉瓦马佐维耶茨卡镇发生。安东尼·耶日奥兰斯基、亚历山大·索科洛夫斯基和弗兰齐谢克·索科洛夫斯基率领的波兰起义军攻占了俄帝国军队的营房，余下的俄军向斯凯尔涅维采撤退。

en.s: The Attack on Dammam was an 1866 assault by the British ship HMS Highflyer to destroy a fort held by the Second Saudi state in the vicinity of Dammam following Faisal's invasion of Oman, which was allied with the British. The attack ultimately failed due to the lack of adequate preparatory measures by the British expedition.

zh.s: 1866年，英国“高飞号”军舰袭击达曼附近一座由第二沙特王国控制的堡垒。此次行动是在费萨尔入侵与英国结盟的阿曼之后进行的。由于英国远征军事先准备不足，袭击最终失败。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 4 February 1867. The result was a victory for the opposition, but the government of Joaquim António de Aguiar remained in power until early 1868, following the Janeirinha uprising.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1867年2月4日举行议会选举，反对派获胜。但若阿金·安东尼奥·德·阿吉亚尔政府仍继续执政，直至1868年初一月起义之后才下台。

en.s: The 1868 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on February 4, 1868, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Republican William Hugh Smith ran unopposed. This is the first time that a Republican became governor of Alabama.

zh.s: 1868年2月4日，阿拉巴马州举行州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·休·史密斯无人竞争，自动当选。这是共和党人首次当选阿拉巴马州州长。

en.s: The Battle of Ordashu was fought on 4 February 1874 during the Third Anglo-Ashanti War when Sir Garnet Wolseley defeated the Ashantis. The attack was led by the 42nd Regiment of Foot. Lieutenant Mark Sever Bell won the Victoria Cross during the action. Wolseley's troops, marching from Amoaful, linked up with King Attah's group, marching from Kumasi, on the south bank of the River Oda (a tributary of the Ofin River), where the battle with the Ashantis took place.

zh.s: 1874年2月4日，第三次英阿散蒂战争期间，加内特·沃尔斯利爵士击败阿散蒂人。第42步兵团率先发动进攻，马克·塞尔·贝尔中尉在战斗中获得维多利亚十字勋章。沃尔斯利的部队从阿莫阿富尔行军而来，与从库马西出发的阿塔国王一方会合；双方在奥达河（奥芬河支流）南岸与阿散蒂人交战。

en.s: The 1887 New South Wales colonial election was held between 4 February and 26 February 1887. This election was for all of the 124 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 37 single-member constituencies, 23 2-member constituencies, seven 3-member constituencies and five 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

en.s: The 1888 Scottish Cup final played at the second Hampden Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 4 February 1888 was won by Renton, who beat Cambuslang 6–1. Renton were favourites going into the match, the Dunbartonshire club having already lifted the trophy in 1885 and finished runners-up to Queen's Park in 1886; in contrast, it was Cambuslang's first and only major final, though the Lanarkshire side had won the first edition of the Glasgow Cup a week earlier, beating Rangers.

zh.s: 1888年苏格兰杯决赛于1888年2月4日在克罗斯希尔的第二座汉普顿公园举行，该地如今属于格拉斯哥。伦顿队以6比1击败坎布斯朗队夺冠。赛前，伦顿队被看好；这支邓巴顿郡球队曾于1885年夺冠，并于1886年获得亚军。坎布斯朗队则首次也是唯一一次打进重要赛事决赛，不过该队一周前刚在首届格拉斯哥杯中击败流浪者队。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the South African Republic between 3 January and 4 February 1898. The result was a victory for incumbent Paul Kruger.

zh.s: 南非共和国于1898年1月3日至2月4日举行总统选举，结果是时任总统保罗·克鲁格获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Manila, the first and largest battle of the Philippine–American War, was fought on February 4–5, 1899, between 19,000 Americans and 15,000 Filipinos. Armed conflict broke out when American troops, under orders to turn away insurgents from their encampment, fired upon an encroaching group of Filipinos. Philippine President Emilio Aguinaldo attempted to broker a ceasefire, but American General Elwell Stephen Otis rejected it and fighting escalated the next day. It ended in an American victory, although minor skirmishes continued for several days afterward.

zh.s: 1899年2月4日至5日，19000名美军与15000名菲律宾军队在马尼拉交战，这是美菲战争第一场、也是规模最大的战役。美军奉命阻止起义军接近营地，向一批靠近的菲律宾人开枪，武装冲突由此爆发。菲律宾总统埃米利奥·阿奎纳多试图促成停火，但美国将军埃尔韦尔·斯蒂芬·奥蒂斯拒绝，战斗次日升级。战役以美军获胜告终，但小规模交火又持续了数天。

en.s: The Philippine–American War, known alternatively as the Filipino–American War, Philippine Insurrection, or Tagalog Insurgency, emerged in early 1899 following the United States' annexation of the former Spanish colony of the Philippine Islands under the terms of the December 1898 Treaty of Paris following the Spanish–American War. Philippine nationalists had proclaimed independence in June 1898 and constituted the First Philippine Republic in January 1899. The United States did not recognize either event as legitimate, and tensions escalated until fighting commenced on February 4, 1899, in the Battle of Manila.

zh.s: 美菲战争也被称为菲律宾起义或他加禄叛乱，始于1899年初。美西战争结束后，美国依据1898年12月《巴黎条约》，吞并原西班牙殖民地菲律宾群岛。菲律宾民族主义者已于1898年6月宣布独立，并在1899年1月建立菲律宾第一共和国，但美国不承认这些举动的合法性。双方紧张关系不断升级，最终于1899年2月4日爆发马尼拉战役。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary between 26 January and 4 February 1905. The result was a victory for the Party of Independence and '48, marking the first time the Liberal Party had lost power since 1875. Because of bad decisions after the elections, the Parliament was dissolved in 1906. Franz Joseph I of Austria ignored the result and instead of the victorious allied opposition he kept István Tisza in power, and then on 18 June he nominated baron Géza Fejérváry mashal (the captain of his Hungarian bodyguards) as acting Prime Minister, which deepened the crisis.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1905年1月26日至2月4日举行议会选举，独立与四八党获胜，自由党自1875年以来首次失去权力。但奥地利皇帝弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世无视结果，没有让获胜的反对派联盟执政，而是继续让蒂萨·伊什特万掌权，随后又于6月18日任命匈牙利近卫军统领费耶尔瓦里·盖佐男爵为代理首相，加深了危机。选后的一连串错误决策最终导致议会于1906年被解散。

en.s: The 1914 Peruvian coup d'état took place on February 4, 1914, headed by Colonel Óscar R. Benavides, who a day earlier was removed from his position as chief of the Army General Staff. The coup was aimed at preventing Guillermo Billinghurst's government from dissolving the Peruvian Congress, which opposed him. It was the first successful coup d'état of the 20th century in Peru.

zh.s: 1914年2月4日，奥斯卡·R.贝纳维德斯上校领导秘鲁政变。他在前一天刚被解除陆军总参谋长职务。政变旨在阻止吉列尔莫·比林赫斯特政府解散反对他的秘鲁国会。这是秘鲁20世纪首次成功的政变。

en.s: The battle of Kakamas took place in Kakamas, Northern Cape Province of South Africa on 4 February 1915. It was a skirmish for control of two river fords over the Orange River between contingents of a German invasion force and South African armed forces. The South Africans succeed in preventing the Germans gaining control of the fords and crossing the river.

zh.s: 1915年2月4日，德军入侵部队与南非军队的一部分，在南非北开普省卡卡马斯发生小规模交战，争夺奥兰治河上的两处渡口。南非军队成功阻止德军夺取渡口并过河。

en.s: The raid on the Suez Canal, also known as actions on the Suez Canal, took place between 26 January and 4 February 1915 when a German-led Ottoman force advanced from southern Palestine to attack the British Empire-protected Suez Canal, marking the beginning of the Sinai and Palestine campaign (1915–1918) of World War I (1914–1918). Substantial Ottoman forces crossed the Sinai Peninsula, and a few managed to cross the Canal.

zh.s: 苏伊士运河突袭战又称苏伊士运河行动，发生于1915年1月26日至2月4日。由德国主导的奥斯曼军队从巴勒斯坦南部推进，袭击由大英帝国保护的苏伊士运河，标志着第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役（1915—1918年）开始。大批奥斯曼军队穿越西奈半岛，其中少数成功渡过运河。

en.s: The Battle of Urga was a battle in the Russian civil war. During 1 to 4 February 1921, White Russian soldiers under Baron Roman von Ungern-Sternberg defeated the numerically superior Chinese garrison and subsequently liberated Mongolia from Chinese occupation.

en.s: The Battle of Valsequillo, also known as Battle of Peñarroya, was a diversionary Republican offensive which took place in the Sierra Morena area in southern Extremadura and the north of Andalusia between 5 January and 4 February 1939 during the Spanish Civil War. The main goal of the offensive was to distract forces from the Nationalist offensive against Catalonia, but after having occupied 500 square kilometers the Republican advance was stopped and all the territorial gains were lost to a Nationalist counteroffensive.

zh.s: 巴尔塞基略战役又称佩尼亚罗亚战役，是西班牙内战期间共和国军发动的一场牵制攻势，于1939年1月5日至2月4日在埃斯特雷马杜拉南部和安达卢西亚北部的莫雷纳山区进行。攻势主要为了分散国民军进攻加泰罗尼亚的兵力。共和国军一度占领500平方公里土地，但随后推进受阻，国民军反攻后又夺回全部失地。

en.s: Operation Southeast Croatia (German: Unternehmen Südost Kroatien) was a large-scale German-led counter-insurgency operation conducted in the southeastern parts of the Independent State of Croatia (Croatian: Nezavisna Država Hrvatska, NDH), (modern-day Bosnia and Herzegovina) during World War II. It was the first of two German-led operations targeting mainly Yugoslav Partisans in eastern Bosnia between 15 January and 4 February 1942. Several days after the conclusion of Operation Southeast Croatia, a follow-up operation known as Operation Ozren was carried out between the Bosna and Spreča rivers. Both operations also involved Croatian Home Guard and Italian troops and are associated with what is known as the Second Enemy Offensive (Serbo-Croatian: Druga neprijateljska ofenziva) in post-war Yugoslav historiography.

zh.s: 克罗地亚东南部行动是二战期间德国主导的大规模反游击作战，地点在克罗地亚独立国东南部，即今天的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内。1942年1月15日至2月4日，德军在波斯尼亚东部连续开展两场主要针对南斯拉夫游击队的行动，本次是其中第一场。行动结束数天后，德军又在波斯纳河与斯普雷查河之间发动后续的奥兹伦行动。两场行动均有克罗地亚国土卫队及意大利军队参与，在战后南斯拉夫史学中被归入“敌人第二次进攻”。

en.s: The Abdeen Palace incident was a military confrontation that took place on 4 February 1942 at Abdeen Palace in Cairo, and nearly resulted in the forced abdication of King Farouk I. It is considered a landmark in the history of Egypt.

zh.s: 1942年2月4日，开罗阿卜丁宫发生军事对峙，法鲁克一世国王险些被迫退位。这一事件被视为埃及历史上的重要转折点。

en.s: The Battle of Makassar Strait, also known as the Action of Madura Strait, the Action North of Lombok Strait and the Battle of the Flores Sea, was a naval battle of the Pacific theater of World War II. An American-British-Dutch-Australian (ABDA) fleet—under Schout-bij-nacht (Rear Admiral) Karel Doorman—was on its way to intercept a Japanese invasion convoy reported as bound for Surabaya (its destination was actually Makassar), when it was attacked by 36 Mitsubishi G4M1 "Betty" and 24 Mitsubishi G3M2 "Nell" medium bombers, which forced the fleet to retreat. The battle occurred on 4 February 1942 in the Bali Sea, in south of the Kangean Islands.

zh.s: 望加锡海峡海战又称马都拉海峡行动、龙目海峡以北行动或弗洛勒斯海海战，是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场海战。卡雷尔·杜尔曼少将指挥的美英荷澳联军舰队正准备拦截一支据报驶向泗水的日军登陆船队（实际目的地是望加锡），途中遭36架三菱G4M1“贝蒂”轰炸机和24架三菱G3M2“内尔”中型轰炸机袭击，被迫撤退。海战于1942年2月4日在坎盖安群岛以南的巴厘海发生。

en.s: The Battle of Wau (29 January – 4 February 1943) was a battle in the New Guinea campaign of World War II. Forces of the Empire of Japan sailed from Rabaul and crossed the Solomon Sea and, despite Allied air attacks, successfully reached Lae, where they disembarked. Japanese troops then advanced overland on Wau, an Australian base that potentially threatened the Japanese positions at Salamaua and Lae.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 沃乌战役是第二次世界大战新几内亚战役中的一场战斗，持续时间为1943年1月29日至2月4日。日本帝国军队从拉包尔出发，穿越所罗门海，尽管遭到盟军空袭仍成功抵达莱城并登陆。日军随后陆路向沃乌推进。沃乌是澳大利亚的基地，可能威胁到日军在萨拉莫阿和莱城的阵地。

en.s: Malaya Zemlya (Russian: Малая Земля, lit. "Small Land") was a Soviet uphill outpost on Cape Myskhako (Russian: Мысхако), situated westward from Tsemes Bay on the Black Sea, that was recaptured after battles with the Germans during the Battle of the Caucasus on the night of 4 February 1943. The episode paved way for a Soviet attack on German forces in Novorossiysk.

zh.s: 小地（俄语：Малая Земля，意为“小土地”）是苏军在米斯哈科角的一处高地前哨，位于黑海捷梅斯湾以西。1943年2月4日晚，在高加索战役期间，苏军与德军交战后重新夺回该地。此役为苏军进攻德军占据的新罗西斯克铺平了道路。

en.t: Battle of Pokoku and Irrawaddy River operations
en.s: The Battle of Pakokku and Irrawaddy River operations were a series of battles fought between the British Indian Army and the Imperial Japanese Army and allied forces over the successful Allied Burma campaign on the China Burma India Theater during World War II. The battles and operations were instrumental in facilitating the eventual capture of Rangoon in summer 1945.
en.n: World War II: The British Indian Army and Imperial Japanese Army begin a series of battles known as the Battle of Pokoku and Irrawaddy River operations.

zh.s: 帕科库战役和伊洛瓦底江作战是第二次世界大战期间缅甸战役的一系列战斗，交战双方是英属印度军队与日本帝国陆军及其盟军。这些战斗和行动为1945年夏季盟军最终攻占仰光创造了重要条件。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：英属印度军队与日本帝国陆军开始展开一系列战斗，史称帕科库战役及伊洛瓦底江作战。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1948 was held on 4 February 1948. The 147 newly elected members of the 13th Dáil assembled on 18 February when the First Inter-Party government in the history of the Irish state was appointed. The general election took place in 40 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 147 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann. For this election the membership of the Dáil was increased to 147 seats, an increase of 9 since the previous election. The 1948 general election is considered an important election in 20th-century Ireland, as it paved the way for the First Inter-Party Government.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1948年2月4日举行大选，在全国40个选区选出众议院147名议员。此次众议院比上届增加九席，达到147席。新当选的第13届众议院议员于2月18日首次开会，同日组成爱尔兰国家历史上首个跨党派联合政府。因此，这次大选被视为20世纪爱尔兰的一次重要选举。

en.s: The Angolan War of Independence (Portuguese: Guerra de Independência de Angola; 1961–1974), known as the Armed Struggle of National Liberation (Portuguese: Luta Armada de Libertação Nacional) in Angola, was a war of independence fought by the Angolan nationalist forces of the MPLA, UNITA and FNLA against Portugal. It began as an uprising by Angolans against the Portuguese imposition of forced cultivation of only cotton as a commodity crop.

zh.s: 安哥拉独立战争（葡萄牙语：Guerra de Independência de Angola；1961—1974年）在安哥拉也称“民族解放武装斗争”（葡萄牙语：Luta Armada de Libertação Nacional），是安哥拉民族主义力量安哥拉人民解放运动、安盟和安哥拉民族解放阵线与葡萄牙之间的一场独立战争。战争起初是安哥拉人反抗葡萄牙强制种植棉花这一经济作物的起义。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iran in 1961, after the elections the previous year had been annulled by the Shah. Among opposition, only Allahyar Saleh was able to win a seat in his native Kashan.

zh.s: 1961年，伊朗举行议会选举。此前一年的选举已被国王宣布无效。民族主义者党获胜，赢得最多席位。民族阵线候选人遭到强行阻止，无法参加竞选，例如伊斯法罕的博鲁曼德。在反对派中，只有阿拉希亚尔·萨利赫在家乡卡尚赢得席位。

en.s: All Nippon Airways Flight 60 was a Boeing 727-81 aircraft making a domestic commercial flight in Japan from Sapporo Chitose Airport to Tokyo Haneda International Airport. On February 4, 1966, the plane crashed into Tokyo Bay about 10.4 km (6.5 mi; 5.6 nmi) from Haneda in clear weather conditions while on a night approach. All 133 people on board died.

zh.s: 全日空60号班机由一架波音727-81执行，是从札幌千岁机场飞往东京羽田国际机场的日本国内商业航班。1966年2月4日，飞机在天气晴朗的夜间进场过程中，坠入距羽田约10.4公里（6.5英里、5.6海里）的东京湾，机上133人全部遇难。

en.s: The 1970–71 Durand Cup final was the 66th final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giants East Bengal and Mohun Bagan on 4 February 1971 at the Corporation Stadium in New Delhi. East Bengal won the final 2–0 to claim their 6th Durand Cup title. Mohammed Habib scored both the goals in the final as East Bengal lifted their sixth Durand Cup title.

zh.s: 1970—1971年杜兰德杯决赛是第66届赛事的决赛。杜兰德杯是印度历史最悠久的足球赛事。本场比赛于1971年2月4日在新德里市政体育场举行，由加尔各答两支劲旅东孟加拉和莫亨巴根交锋。穆罕默德·哈比卜包办两粒进球，帮助东孟加拉以2比0获胜，第六次捧起杜兰德杯。

en.s: The M62 coach bombing happened on 4 February 1974 on the M62 motorway in northern England, when a Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) bomb exploded in a coach carrying off-duty British Armed Forces personnel and their family members. Twelve people (nine soldiers, three civilians) were killed by the bomb, which consisted of 25 pounds (11 kg) of high explosive hidden in a luggage locker on the coach. Judith Ward was convicted of the crime later in 1974, but 18 years later the conviction was judged as wrongful and she was released from prison.

zh.s: 1974年2月4日，英格兰北部M62高速公路上一辆载有休假英军人员及家属的客车，遭临时爱尔兰共和军炸弹袭击。藏在车内行李舱的25磅（11公斤）高爆炸药爆炸，造成12人死亡，包括九名军人和三名平民。朱迪思·沃德于当年被判犯下此案，但18年后其定罪被认定为冤案，她获释出狱。

en.s: The battle of Jolo, also referred to as the burning of Jolo or the siege of Jolo, was a military confrontation between the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the government of the Philippines in February 1974 in the municipality of Jolo, in the southern Philippines. It is considered one of the key early incidents of the Moro insurgency in the Philippines, and led numerous Moro leaders to resist martial law under Ferdinand Marcos.

zh.s: 1974年2月，菲律宾南部霍洛市镇发生霍洛岛战役，又称霍洛岛焚城或霍洛岛围城战。交战双方是摩洛民族解放阵线（MNLF）和菲律宾政府。这是摩洛叛乱初期的重要事件之一，促使许多摩洛领导人反抗费迪南德·马科斯实施的戒严令。

en.s: The 1975 Haicheng earthquake, hit Haicheng, Liaoning in China at 19:36 CST on February 4. The earthquake registered at 7.3 on the Richter Scale, which is associated with total destruction of infrastructure and property. Haicheng had approximately 1 million residents at the time of the earthquake, which is known for being one of the few earthquakes to be successfully predicted throughout history. Early in the morning of February 4, 1975, Chinese officials ordered that the city of Haicheng be evacuated, believing there to be a large chance of an earthquake occurring.

zh.s: 1975年2月4日北京时间19时36分，中国辽宁海城发生里氏7.3级地震，对基础设施和财产造成毁灭性破坏。当时海城约有100万居民。这次地震是历史上少数得到成功预报的地震之一。2月4日清晨，有关部门认为当地发生地震的可能性很大，下令疏散海城居民。

en.s: The 1997 Israeli helicopter disaster occurred on 4 February 1997. 73 Israel Defense Forces soldiers were killed when two Sikorsky S-65C-3 Yas'ur 2000 helicopters, 357 and 903, collided over She'ar Yashuv in northern Israel. The helicopters were supposed to cross the border into Israel's "security zone" in southern Lebanon, but were hovering while waiting for official clearance to go. Previously Israel had moved troops by ground, but this policy was changed as the threat of roadside bombs from Hezbollah increased. Bodies were brought to the Reading Funeral Home in North Tel Aviv, where identifications were made. The crash brought about widespread national grieving.

en.s: On 4 February 2025, a school shooting occurred at Campus Risbergska, an adult education center in Örebro, Sweden. The shooter was identified as 35-year-old Rickard Andersson, who killed ten people and wounded six others before committing suicide. As of May 2025, the Swedish Police Authority appeared to close their investigation, stating the perpetrator likely targeted Campus Risbergska because he was previously enrolled there for some time, and that his attack was primarily motivated by suicidal thoughts.

zh.s: 2025年2月4日，瑞典厄勒布鲁的里斯贝里斯卡成人教育中心发生校园枪击案。枪手被确认为35岁的里卡德·安德松，他杀死十人、打伤六人后自杀。截至2025年5月，瑞典警方似乎已结束调查，并表示枪手很可能因曾在那里就读而选定该校，袭击的主要动机是自杀念头。

en.s: The 2024 Bulgarian Supercup was the 21st edition of the Bulgarian Supercup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's First League and the Bulgarian Cup.
